# TOMUPRO - AI Logistics Platform & Delivery Service in Brunei

> TOMUPRO is a logistics and delivery management platform in Brunei.

## About

TOMUPRO is an AI-powered logistics platform in Brunei that provides last-mile delivery, fulfillment services, and delivery management systems for businesses. Our system helps companies automate dispatch, track deliveries in real-time, and optimize routes for faster and more efficient operations.

## Services

- Last-mile delivery service in Brunei
- Trusted courier service across all Brunei districts
- Order fulfillment and warehouse management
- Cash on delivery (COD) with automated reconciliation
- AI-powered dispatch management system
- Real-time delivery tracking system
- Fleet and driver management
- Route optimization
- Inventory control
- Financial reconciliation

## Service Areas

TOMUPRO provides delivery coverage across all four districts in Brunei Darussalam:

- **Brunei-Muara District**: Bandar Seri Begawan, Gadong, Kiulap, Berakas, Kiarong, Rimba, Mentiri, Muara
- **Belait District**: Kuala Belait, Seria, Labi, Sungai Liang, Lumut
- **Tutong District**: Tutong Town, Pekan Tutong
- **Temburong District**: Bangar Town

## Target Customers

- eCommerce businesses in Brunei
- Retail chains and stores
- Logistics companies
- Warehouse and 3PL operators
- Food and beverage delivery
- SMEs and startups

## Location

Brunei Darussalam — serving Bandar Seri Begawan, Kuala Belait, Seria, Tutong, Muara, and all districts nationwide.
